core_principles.name: causal_abstention
core_principles.rule: A code-derived observation may describe a property of supplied bytes but may not identify why that property is present or who produced it.

core_principles.name: typed_applicability
core_principles.rule: Unavailable, inapplicable and unobserved values are distinct states and none is encoded as zero.

core_principles.name: non_compensation
core_principles.rule: Evidence in one review dimension may not cancel evidence in an unrelated dimension.

core_principles.name: traceable_action
core_principles.rule: Every suggested action must cite the observations and source evidence that warrant it and must remain reversible.

core_principles.name: non_equivalent_legacy_migration
core_principles.rule: Legacy scalar fields are preserved only as read-only historical semantics and are never silently translated into the v3 construct.

allowed_interpretations: The supplied artefact contains structures that may increase comprehension or testing burden.
Complexity is concentrated or dispersed across identified entities.
dimensions.evidence_gate: Retain only after metric-level specifications and metamorphic tests in S02-S03.
dimensions.label: Structural complexity and dispersion
metamorphic_expectations: formatting-only changes should not alter structural counts
semantics-preserving extraction should preserve entity identity where the adapter supports it
permitted_actions: Ask whether a named function can be decomposed without obscuring domain logic.
Inspect whether tests cover the identified branch or nesting concentration.

allowed_interpretations: A reviewer may benefit from inspecting whether selected names communicate their local role.
dimensions.evidence_gate: Expert content mapping and language-specific specification are required before empirical interpretation.
dimensions.label: Clarity and naming evidence
metamorphic_expectations: consistent alpha-renaming may change naming evidence but must not change unrelated dimensions
permitted_actions: Pose a source-local naming question with counterexamples.
Suggest a reversible rename only when references are traceable.

allowed_interpretations: Specific documentation statements may be inconsistent with inspectable implementation evidence.
dimensions.evidence_gate: Each alignment rule requires an independently checkable reference contract.
dimensions.label: Documentation–implementation alignment
metamorphic_expectations: unrelated prose edits should not change implementation correspondence
permitted_actions: Ask the author to reconcile a named statement and implementation location.
Suggest updating or removing a stale reference.

allowed_interpretations: An identified operation may have an unexamined or weakly evidenced failure path.
dimensions.evidence_gate: Static observations must be separated from executed failure evidence.
dimensions.label: Defensive explicitness and failure handling
metamorphic_expectations: adding a tested failure branch may alter this dimension but must not improve unrelated evidence by compensation
permitted_actions: Ask how a named failure is represented and tested.
Suggest a bounded negative test tied to the source location.

allowed_interpretations: Selected repeated structures may warrant a maintainability review.
dimensions.evidence_gate: Clone and scaffold controls are mandatory before interpretation.
dimensions.label: Repetition, redundancy and maintainability signals
metamorphic_expectations: extracting a shared helper should alter only mapped repetition observations unless other code properties actually change
permitted_actions: Ask whether repetition is intentional domain duplication or a refactoring opportunity.

allowed_interpretations: The supplied project packet has a specific provenance, intake or dependency-boundary issue.
dimensions.evidence_gate: S03 must revalidate the historical intake and release-integrity requirements.
dimensions.label: Project intake and dependency hygiene
metamorphic_expectations: reordering archive entries must not change admitted-file identity or hygiene findings
permitted_actions: Request a cleaner project packet or explicit dependency inventory.
Ask for provenance evidence for a named external resource.
prohibited_inferences: authorship or provenance of source content

allowed_interpretations: The available observations are incomplete or qualified for identified source regions.
dimensions.evidence_gate: Adapter completeness and diagnostic behaviour must be specified in S02-S03.
dimensions.label: Parser scope and unsupported-construct burden
metamorphic_expectations: unsupported-form diagnostics must remain explicit and must not be converted into low evidence
permitted_actions: Ask for an alternative analysis route or manual inspection of the named region.
prohibited_inferences: low quality because the analyser lacks support
